## Scope

Describe one reviewable behavior or refactor.

## Verification

- [ ] `ktlintCheck`
- [ ] `detektMainDesktop detektTestDesktop`

## Reviewability

- [ ] Mechanical formatting is separate from behavior changes

- [ ] No static-analysis baseline was expanded without explanation
